The remaining duration between today (August 27, 2026) and the deadline is approximately 70 days. The standard Senate process for a presidential nomination requires: (1) receipt of the nomination by the Senate and referral to the relevant committee (Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions - HELP); (2) the submission of standard background financial disclosure forms and completion of an FBI background check; (3) the scheduling and holding of a confirmation hearing by the committee; (4) a committee vote to report the nomination favorably to the full Senate; and (5) floor scheduling, debate, and a final confirmation floor vote.
